ROOT.triggerdef: CREATE TRIGGER [TwrLastModC] ON [CDN].[TwrKarty] FOR INSERT, UPDATE AS BEGIN IF NOT UPDATE(Twr_Oddzialowy) BEGIN UPDATE T SET T.Twr_LastModC = DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(DATETIME,'1990-01-01',120),GETDATE()) FROM CDN.TwrKarty T, inserted WHERE T.Twr_GIDNumer = inserted.Twr_GIDNumer END END
